A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same survey and empirical benchmark, Discrete Audio Tokens: More Than a Survey! Their text, equations, tables and figures support reliable comparison. v1 ends with references; v3 additionally contains readable Appendices A–C.

before.justification: Sections 3–4 report original tokenizer benchmarks, language-model experiments and controlled training ablations, rather than only summarizing previously published results.

after.justification: v3 retains the original experiments in Sections 3–4 and adds UTMOS V2 reconstruction scores in Appendix A, Table 17.

M1.justification: The benchmark models, training procedures and controlled tokenizer variants remain unchanged. Expanded descriptions of losses, disentanglement and cited methods explain existing approaches without changing the work's experimental methods.

E1.justification: The speech, music and general-audio datasets, languages and tasks remain unchanged. Appendix C consolidates existing datasets and documents their durations; Appendix A does not introduce a new dataset or task.

E2.justification: Corresponding experiments retain the same tokenizer and continuous-baseline comparisons. Section 3 newly explains tokenizer-selection criteria, but does not change membership. LAST, ERVQ and VQGAN are added to the literature discussion, not evaluated as new comparators.

E3.justification: Appendix A adds UTMOS V2 as an additional reconstruction-quality metric while retaining the existing evaluations. The SI-SDRi explanation in Section 3.2 clarifies a metric already labeled in v1 Table 9. Newly disclosed hardware and dataset durations do not establish changed experimental settings.

E4.justification: The controlled analyses of training domain, sampling rate, quantization and semantic distillation remain unchanged, including Tables 14–16. Appendix A supplies additional metric scores for existing tokenizer configurations, without introducing a distinct ablation, robustness test or diagnostic analysis.

E5.justification: Both versions report downstream averages over three runs with different random seeds and retain the same plus/minus reporting. The new UTMOS V2 table gives point estimates without adding run counts, confidence intervals or statistical tests.

E6.justification: Table 17 adds 15 UTMOS V2 scores, including 3.19 for SQ-SMA-16 at 3 kbps and 3.12 for WT-S-24 at 0.52 kbps. Existing numerical results in the main tables remain unchanged. These are additional metric results, not performance improvements under the original UTMOS metric.

T1.justification: Section 2.4.2 adds explicit definitions of binary masking, masked inputs and the masked-prediction loss, previously described only verbally. Section 2.4.3 adds latent-factor mappings for disentanglement and discusses ideally orthogonal components. No theorem or proof is added.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution statements and conclusion retain the same claims: a refined tokenizer taxonomy, unified evaluation across three audio domains, and controlled ablations revealing task-dependent trade-offs. The additional material does not redefine these contributions.

C2.justification: Section 3.1 replaces the erroneous description of SQ-Codec as speech-only and out-of-domain with an explanation centered on WT-S-24's domain mismatch and WavTokenizer's bitrate and loss limitations. v3 also expands the codebook-collapse explanation and clarifies the interpretation of existing SI-SDRi results.

D1.justification: Appendix B supplements existing training details with GPU configurations and approximate runtimes across experimental families, including 96 hours on one A100 80GB for TTS. Appendix C adds consolidated dataset durations and source links. These are documentation additions rather than demonstrated changes to execution.

R1.justification: v3 adds discussion and citations for LAST, ERVQ and VQGAN, expanding coverage of separate training, codebook utilization and adversarial modeling. The broader taxonomy and positioning relative to earlier surveys and benchmarks remain unchanged.

P1.justification: v3 makes localized wording corrections, expands explanations of SSL, training objectives, tokenizer selection and acoustic language models, and adds Appendices A–C. The main section order and narrative remain intact; author-credit and publication text also receive small edits.

P2.justification: v3 adds Tables 17–19 for UTMOS V2 scores, computational resources and dataset summaries. Existing figures and main-table designs are retained, with changes to placement and page flow. Publication headers are added throughout.

improvement.justification: v3 improves reproducibility through hardware, runtime and dataset disclosures, adds perceptual-quality evidence, and corrects the out-of-domain tokenizer discussion. These gains are limited: the central experiments and conclusions remain unchanged, the UTMOS V2 results receive little explanation, and the added SI-SDRi example contains a malformed '-7-7 dB' value. Overall, documentation and interpretive accuracy improve modestly.
